reviewer.basis: Direct script and runbook inspection, local bash syntax validation, and SHA-256 verification.

target.purpose: Read-only point-in-time listener and service verification after an independently authorized first installation.

false_positive_controls_reviewed: systemctl, ss and curl query failures reject the check.
Expected unit hash, fragment, absence of drop-ins, effective ExecStart, User, Group and Environment are checked.
MainPID, running executable path/hash, installed executable hash and listener owner PID are correlated.
MainPID is compared before and after HTTP verification to detect a service restart during the check.
TCP listeners across IPv4 and IPv6 are inspected; exactly one 127.0.0.1:8787 listener is required.
curl -q disables user configuration, proxy use is disabled, and /login must return HTTP 200.

secrets_and_side_effects.root_requirement: Socket ownership and /proc executable inspection require root visibility; the script does not change service configuration.

limitations: Static review and bash syntax validation do not establish runtime success on sense.
The script checks a point in time and does not guarantee continued service operation or continued privacy.
Separate-host LAN IPv4 and global IPv6 checks remain required; timeout, missing routing and test-origin failures are inconclusive.
Direct port 8787 refusal does not rule out publication through another port, tunnel, proxy, ingress, CI or preview route.
The script explicitly reports EXTERNAL_ROUTE=unverified; private-ready requires separate reachability evidence.
This code_review allow does not authorize transfer, host installation, service changes, reboot or remote mutations.
